journey:J01.description: new product: Help/orientation → Configure Init → Setup new → mode selection → Plan discovery/personas/brief/PRD/stories → Design architecture/spec/flows → Build tests/implementation/verify → authorized fixture ship → fresh Status/Go. Gate decisions, artifact privacy, receipts and final state all agree.

journey:J02.description: adopt existing: Organized and inherited fixtures → setup detection/stage/tracker → preserve code/tests/settings → next-work proposal → selected delivery. Repeat with partial setup and declined activation.

journey:J03.description: local coordination: Theme/goal/milestone/epic → issue creation/link/dependency → triage/backlog → sprint where allowed → review → close → reopen → decline → read-only views and cache. Verify exact folders, IDs, audit and user status intent.

journey:J04.description: GitHub coordination: Local→GitHub tracker → list/view/create/edit/triage/close/reopen/decline → remote readback → GitHub→local. Local sentinel hashes stay fixed; explicit import/sync is a separate request. Fail auth/origin/label/permission and interrupt after remote create.

journey:J05.description: controlled delivery: Small and large story from each entry → frozen binary criteria → phases and enforcement probe → test-first implementation → criterion evidence → ship/finalize → restart and no unfinished work. Repeat with stale evidence, tampering, amendment and stop guard.

journey:J06.description: production incident: Reproducible failing local release → runbook/triage → classify → fix vs rollback → test/review → local deploy → smoke → required postmortem → action items and state. Failed smoke leaves incident unresolved.

journey:J07.description: security patch: Vulnerability reproduction → severity/blast radius → approved patch → tests → mandatory security review → ship → disclosure/follow-up. Denied security gate cannot be waved through by a generic proceed.

journey:J08.description: upgrade and recovery: Disposable install old version → channel/version checks → update → drift/migration → corrupt/interrupted run → diagnose/plan/snapshot/approve/execute → verify → rollback/resume → doctor → graduation. Each no-op, refusal and irrecoverable stop preserves data.

journey:J09.description: mode transitions: All 12 directed transitions between four modes → upshift requirements/downshift cleanup → effective gates → implementation boundary → snapshot restore/history. Same-mode and invalid-mode requests separately.

journey:J10.description: corpus: Onboard → consolidate → classify all four outcomes → reconcile conflicts → approve/promote → RAG setup → query known fact → reindex → live counts → pause/resume/offboard. Preserve source, exclusions, canonical status and deletion confirmations.

journey:J11.description: product evidence: Research/discovery → personas → synthetic study → assumptions → positioning/messaging/narrative → brief/PRD → course correction → revised scope and in-flight work. Synthetic evidence never becomes claimed customer validation.

journey:J12.description: mockup: Sandbox → extract actual component/tokens → iterate → approve → graduate → route/test/acceptance criteria → cleanup choice. Unsupported imports and failed type checks stop truthful graduation.

journey:J13.description: academic work: Corpus/context → first principles → literature → venue/outline → modular drafting → scored review/revision → submission preparation. Fail each numeric quality gate and a missing citation; no invented submission.

journey:J14.description: interruption: Start work → detour/nested detour → explicit stop → restart/compression → resume from durable checkpoint → final verification. No tool mutation after stop and before renewed authority.

journey:J15.description: removal: Guardian off vs framework off vs hibernate vs feature pause vs purge: exercise separately → new session silence/preservation → explicit reactivation/re-onboarding. Wrong confirmations and partial deletion never report removal complete.

non_optional_invariants: Owned disposable fixtures and explicit mutation authority remain mandatory.
Runtime startup checks, gates, approvals and evidence rules cannot be disabled by cluster selection.
Routing plans stop before executing the selected operation; permitted startup bookkeeping is separately recorded.
An excluded skill may remain a runtime dependency; no excluded standalone test is silently scheduled.
Explicit stop, credential isolation and preservation of unrelated work always apply.
Never interpret omitted, blocked, oracle-gap or planned coverage as passing.
The selection tool only previews scope and never starts Claude, a model, a browser, a provider or a test subprocess.
